meta.name: ot-project-description-builder
meta.description: Build milestone-based project descriptions for Other Transaction (OT) agreements under 10 USC 4021/4022. Produces the agreement attachment that replaces a SOW/PWS in OT prototype and production follow-on contexts. Structures work around TRL progression phases (design, build, test, demonstrate) with milestone payment schedules tied to technical deliverables. Trigger for: OT project description, OTA project description, other transaction agreement, prototype agreement, OT scope, 10 USC 4021, 10 USC 4022, prototype OT, production follow-on OT, TRL-based project description, milestone-based scope, write an OT project description. Also trigger when user needs a project description before an OT cost analysis or has a BAA white paper/SOO to develop. Never contains cost estimates, funding profiles, or cost-sharing calculations. Do NOT use for SOW/PWS (use sow-pws-builder), OT cost analysis (use OT Cost Analysis), or FAR Part 15 requirements.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 生成基于里程碑的OT项目描述附件
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要为其他交易协议撰写结构化项目描述。
copy.tagline_en: Build milestone-based OT project description attachments
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to write structured project descriptions for Other Transaction agreements.

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 会引导你通过一系列结构化问题，生成一份基于里程碑的“其他交易协议”项目描述文档（.docx），并输出一个内部使用的里程碑交接表。该文档替代传统的SOW/PWS，围绕技术成熟度等级（TRL）阶段组织工作，不包含成本估算。
howto.when: 当你提到“OT项目描述”、“原型协议”、“TRL项目描述”等关键词，或需要将现有SOW/白皮书转换为OT项目描述，或需要缩减已有项目范围时触发。

say.text: 帮我写一份OT原型项目描述，TRL从4到6。
say.note: 启动完整构建流程，Claude会询问项目背景和里程碑。

say.text: 把这个SOW转换成OT项目描述。
say.note: 启动文档转换流程，Claude会提取内容并识别差距。

say.text: 这个原型太贵了，帮我缩减范围。
